description: Entivita — a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that displays player, mob, and living entity health with numeric values and Minecraft-style heart indicators.

mods.name: Entivita
mods.description: Immersive combat HUD that displays real-time health indicators directly above players and entities.

releases.notes:
## Entivita 1.1.1-beta3

This release focuses on improving the health indicator rendering system and fixing several HUD-related issues.

### Improvements

* Improved the positioning of health hearts above players and living entities.
* Improved heart stacking and row alignment when displaying additional hearts.
* Improved the handling of health and absorption hearts.
* Improved heart size and vertical offset controls.
* Improved heart texture rendering for clearer and more consistent visuals.
* Improved HUD rendering behavior when using F1 and third-person views.
* Reduced unnecessary rendering work to improve performance.
* Moved client messages to language files for better localization support.

### Fixes

* Fixed hearts appearing too high above entities.
* Fixed incorrect heart counts when entities have additional health.
* Fixed issues with multiple rows of hearts not being centered correctly.
* Fixed health indicators disappearing or appearing incorrectly depending on the camera/HUD state.
* Fixed several rendering inconsistencies with heart textures.

### Localization

Added and updated translations for:

* English (`en_us.json`)
* Russian (`ru_ru.json`)

### Notes

This is a beta release. The health indicator rendering system is still being refined, and additional improvements may be made in future releases.

## Entivita 1.1.1-beta2

This beta release improves the health indicator positioning and rendering system.

### Changes
- Added automatic health indicator positioning based on entity height.
- Improved positioning across different living entity sizes.
- Reduced excessive vertical spacing above entities.
- Improved spacing when health indicators use multiple rows.
- Improved health indicator rendering stability.
- Continued refinement of the configuration system.

### Beta Notes
This is a beta release and further adjustments may be made to health indicator positioning in future versions.

If you encounter positioning issues with specific entities, please report the entity name and, if possible, include a screenshot.
